title: ADD COLUMN NOT NULL with no default
notes: Fails outright on a non-empty table: PostgreSQL raises NotNullViolation.

title: SET NOT NULL on a populated column
notes: Full scan under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, and it fails while NULLs exist.

title: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY
notes: SHARE lock blocks every INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE for the whole build.

title: DROP COLUMN still referenced by deployed code
notes: Irreversible data loss plus instant breakage of running application code.

title: ALTER COLUMN TYPE forcing a rewrite
notes: int -> bigint is not binary coercible: whole-table rewrite under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE.

title: ADD FOREIGN KEY without NOT VALID
notes: Scans and locks both tables; the NOT VALID + VALIDATE split avoids it.

title: RENAME a column that is in use
notes: No overlap window: every running process breaks the moment it commits.

title: Unbounded UPDATE backfill
notes: Rewrites every row in one transaction: long locks, WAL spike, bloat.

title: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY inside a transaction
notes: PostgreSQL refuses: CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.

title: ADD UNIQUE constraint inline
notes: Builds the unique index inline under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE.

title: ADD COLUMN with a volatile DEFAULT
notes: A volatile default defeats the PG11 fast path and rewrites the table.

title: DROP TABLE
notes: Total data loss; also fails or cascades depending on dependencies.

title: TRUNCATE in a migration
notes: Deletes every row under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE.

title: Realistic release migration with four problems
notes: The shape of a real end-of-sprint migration: several risks in one file.

title: DROP INDEX without CONCURRENTLY
notes: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on the table for the duration of the drop.

title: Otherwise-fine DDL with no lock_timeout
notes: PG11+ fast path makes this cheap, but with no lock_timeout it can still queue behind a long query and freeze the table. The interesting failure mode for reviewers is over-reporting a rewrite here.

title: ADD COLUMN with a constant default
notes: PG11+ stores the default in the catalogue: no rewrite, no scan.

title: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction
notes: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE: writes keep working.

title: NOT VALID then VALIDATE
notes: The textbook two-step: brief lock, then a non-blocking validation scan.

title: CREATE TABLE plus its index
notes: A brand new table has no traffic; indexing it blocks nobody.

title: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY
notes: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE only.

title: Index on a column that does not exist
notes: Looks like the safe pattern. orders.shipped_at was never added, so the deploy aborts. Only executing it finds this.

title: Typo that only the server catches
notes: `CONSTRAIN` instead of `CONSTRAINT`. The first statement commits, the second aborts: a half-applied migration.

title: NOT VALID then VALIDATE on data that violates it
notes: Textbook-correct shape, wrong predicate. VALIDATE fails on existing rows. A linter sees the safe pattern and approves it.

title: Unique index over values a backfill just duplicated
notes: Each statement is defensible alone; together the second cannot succeed. Requires reasoning about the data the first statement produced.

title: DROP COLUMN with a view depending on it
notes: PostgreSQL refuses because a view depends on the column; CASCADE would silently drop the view instead.

title: Widening varchar(50) to varchar(200)
notes: Binary coercible: PostgreSQL only updates the catalogue, relfilenode is unchanged. Reviewers routinely call this a full rewrite.

title: SET NOT NULL with a validated CHECK already in place
notes: PG12+ uses the validated CHECK to skip the full scan. The rule-based linter cannot see that and reports a scan that will not happen.

title: ADD COLUMN NOT NULL *with* a constant default
notes: The PG11 fast path: no rewrite, no scan. Frequently confused with the genuinely broken no-default version.
